guard: a persona that names no channel is scoped to its spawner's ACL, joins only what join names, never inherits the spawner's event channel, and a persona that names channels ignores callerAcl
why: The peer door now sends the caller's own ACL and a join list. Three ways to get the rule wrong
each read as a product bug in a different place: the scoped ACL applied over a persona that
names its own (a helper wider or narrower than its file says), join dropped (the helper starts
on nothing and its first send is refused, the live defect), and the spawner's event channel
carried into the child (the launch refuses as asking for another agent's event plane).

mutations.name: M1 scope to the caller even when the persona names channels
mutations.expectRed: a persona naming only subscribe keeps its empty post ACL despite callerAcl

mutations.name: M2 drop join from the joined set
mutations.expectRed: the seat joins only what join named

mutations.name: M3 carry the spawner's event channel into the child's ACL
mutations.expectRed: a channel-less persona spawns under its spawner's ACL
